verdict.rationale: The only evidence of local-model operation is one community hands-on report. In it, cua-agent 0.1.29 was run with the OMNI loop and the local gemma3:4b model, but the runs mis-typed or failed to connect. The first-party docs describe pairing Cua Driver with cloud agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and never document local-model support. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of local model providers, evidence of a successful local-only run, and confirmation that device control works without any cloud API.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent runs with a local model, so device control does not depend on a cloud API
